blind.description: A stylized stone architectural buttress or stepped masonry pillar. It features irregular carved stone blocks with moss-filled joints, narrowing upward in three distinct tiers separated by sloped weathering/capstone ledges, and capped at the top with a small gabled ridge roof. All geometry is solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled with stylized hand-painted textures, sitting directly flat on the ground via its molded bottom course.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a layered rectangular block showing the top gabled roof ridge alongside the two stepped-back inclined capstone ledges descending to the wider base.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1.3 to 1.4 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 7.5 to 8 feet tall), and about 2 to 2.5 feet wide at the base.

notes: footprint is roughly square (3.2 x 3.1 ft) rather than rectangular (2.5 x 4.0 ft), but maintains tall stepped pier silhouette
